complete_examples.text: Section 2 introduces a novel vehicle–track–soil dynamic model based on FEM–DQFEM and details the multi-scale coupled method for FEM–DQFEM co-simulation.

In this section, an improved multi-scale coupled method for FEM– DQFEM co-simulation analysis is applied to model the base plate–soil interaction, based on the multi-scale method proposed in Ref. 35 (Fig. 2).
